role: global interaction metaweb and provenance index
current_note: GloBI provides stable versioned integrated interaction data and record-level dataset citations. For primary inference, retain original-dataset identity and sampling context rather than treating all integrated rows as one homogeneous survey.

Public service exposes network matrices, species lists, references and geographic locations across pollination, seed-dispersal, host-parasite, host-parasitoid, herbivory and other interaction types. Freeze exact downloaded files and original references before response calculation.
Preserved GlobalWeb archive provides food-web matrices. Geographic metadata and sampling comparability must be audited from source studies before cross-site turnover inference.

role: trait-space proof-of-concept and generic estimator implementation
current_note: Validated generic trait-space estimands and non-flower transports. This is method/proof-of-concept evidence, not an empirical replication for the new four-response law.
Cross-radiation flower-colour temporal memory motivates the time axis but remains one phenotype domain and must not be counted as validation of a general trait/interactions law.
Use only after freezing taxonomic resolution, time window, coordinate filters and thinning. Occurrence-derived breadth is a predictor and must be constructed without focal turnover outcomes.
